title: 6.25.3 Lab: Trail online
description: Your Trail plays a classmate on another computer: rolls are sent, every roll is applied in onMove, and only the player whose turn it is may roll.

steps.title: Run it
steps.instructions: This is your game from 6.24.3. It plays on one computer; H does nothing yet.

steps.title: A room and a listener
steps.instructions: At the top, add `const JOIN = '';`. At the end of `setup()`, apply every move: `online.onMove((move, seat) => takeTurn(move.roll));`, then `if (JOIN !== '') online.join(JOIN);`. In `draw()`, `if (kb.presses('h') && online.status === 'off') online.host();`.

steps.title: Send the roll, do not apply it
steps.instructions: In `roll()`, keep the die, then: if `online.status === 'off'`, call `takeTurn(r)` as before; otherwise `online.send({ roll: r })`. The roll comes back in `onMove` on both computers.
hints: Online, a roll applied in `roll()` AND in `onMove` moves the token twice on your screen.

steps.title: Only your seat rolls
steps.instructions: Write `myTurn()`: offline it is always true; online it is true only when `online.status === 'ready'` and `online.seat === turn`. SPACE rolls only when `myTurn()` is true. Let R start a new game only when `online.status === 'off'`, so one computer cannot reset its board alone.
hints: Seat 0 is the host and `players[0]`; seat 1 is the classmate and `players[1]`.

steps.title: Show the room, then play
steps.instructions: In `drawTop()`, show the room code while `online.status === 'waiting'`, `'Online, you are ' + players[online.seat].name` when it is `'ready'`, a hint that H hosts when it is `'off'`, and `online.error` when it is `'error'`. Then host in one tab, join from a second tab (or a classmate's computer), and race.
hints: You must be signed in and in a class to play online.

requirements.title: Rolls are sent
requirements.description: Online, the roll goes out with online.send instead of moving the token. Help: 6.25.1 (Reading: One list of moves, two computers)

requirements.title: Turns are applied in onMove
requirements.description: Every move that arrives runs takeTurn, on both computers. Help: 6.25.1 (Reading: One list of moves, two computers)

requirements.title: Only your seat rolls
requirements.description: Online, SPACE rolls only when online.seat matches turn. Help: 6.25.1 (Reading: One list of moves, two computers)

requirements.title: Offline still works
requirements.description: When online.status is 'off', the game plays on one computer as before. Help: 6.25.1 (Reading: One list of moves, two computers)

aiCheck.rubricTitle: What the AI read in your code
aiCheck.prompt: The student wrote a moSHion sketch for "Lab: Trail online". The task: make the race playable across two computers: set up online.onMove once to call takeTurn with the roll in every move, host on a key or join from a JOIN code, send the roll with online.send instead of applying it when online, let only the player whose seat equals turn roll, and keep offline play working when online.status is off. Accept any names, helpers, ternaries and semicolons; a line only in a comment or string does not count. Short, plain notes for a 14-year-old; never write corrected code.
